title: chlorophytum pygmaeum
intro: Chlorophytum pygmaeum, commonly known as the dwarf spider plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. It is widely recognized for its air-purifying properties and has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The health benefits of Chlorophytum pygmaeum include its ability to alleviate anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system, while its therapeutic actions include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
